## Part 1 · 00:00

[00:00] Happy 20th anniversary, Reasonable Faith. I first encountered Dr. Craig's work many years ago when I was still studying medicine as an undergraduate at National University of Singapore. At the time, I was trying to share the gospel with my friends, and and they asked a lot difficult questions about the Christian faith for which I have no good answers until I came across the writings and the debates of Dr. Craig, which answered a lot of difficult questions that I had. I found Dr. Craig's work to be very helpful for strengthening my faith and for equipping me to share the gospel with my friends.

[00:35] Over the years, I have also encountered scholars who have raised objections to Dr. Craig's arguments, >> [music] >> and responding to these objections has been a focus of my academic career, resulting in publications of many books and articles over the last 10 years. So, I'm very grateful for Dr. Craig's ministry and very grateful to the team at Reasonable Faith for making his work so much more accessible to the wide audience, people around the world.

[01:15] And I hope and pray that God will continue to bless your ministry as you draw closer to him, and that it will continue to bear much more fruits around the world for Christ's kingdom and his glory. Amen.
